description: This file contains internal testing utilities and sample input generators for sparse tensor operations in PyTorch, including validation, error handling, and sample creation for various sparse tensor formats and operations.

methods.name: _check_validate
methods.description: Validates that the operation on a sample either succeeds or raises the expected exception.

methods.name: _sample_inputs_sparse
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for sparse tensor operations, applying validation and handling error samples.

methods.name: _error_inputs_sparse
methods.description: Generates error samples for sparse tensor operations.

methods.name: _apply_requires_grad_to_samples
methods.description: Decorator that clones tensors in samples and sets requires_grad as specified.

methods.name: sample_inputs_sparse_reduction
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for reduction operations on sparse tensors.

methods.name: error_inputs_sparse_reduction_sum
methods.description: Generates error samples for sum reduction on sparse tensors.

methods.name: sample_inputs_sparse_elementwise_binary_operation
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for elementwise binary operations on sparse tensors.

methods.name: _validate_sample_input_elementwise_binary_sparse_mul
methods.description: Validates a sample input for sparse elementwise multiplication, returning ErrorInput if invalid.

methods.name: sample_inputs_sparse_mul
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for sparse multiplication operation.

methods.name: error_inputs_sparse_mul
methods.description: Generates error samples for sparse multiplication.

methods.name: _sample_inputs_sparse_like_fns
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for sparse 'like' functions.

methods.name: _validate_sample_input_sparse_like_fns
methods.description: Validates samples for sparse 'like' functions, returning ErrorInput if invalid.

methods.name: _maybe_failing_sample_inputs_sparse_like_fns
methods.description: Generates samples that are known to fail or have failed in the past for sparse 'like' functions.

methods.name: sample_inputs_sparse_like_fns

methods.description: Generates error samples for sparse 'like' functions.

methods.name: _validate_sample_input_sparse_default
